# Icon Button

## Summary
A button whose label is an icon.

## Shape
`@icon` with `@width`/`@height`, plus `@variant` and `@size` shared with `Button`, `@round` for
the circular form, and `@loading`/`@disabled` for state. Note it takes no `ariaLabel` of its
own: because the visible content is a glyph, the accessible name has to arrive from the caller
via `...attributes` (an `aria-label` or `title` on the element). That is worth stating plainly,
since an icon-only control with no accessible name is the most common way this component is
misused.

## Usage
Rendered in its states by the freestyle usage page at `packages/boxel-ui/src/components/icon-button/usage.gts`.

```gts
import { IconButton } from '@cardstack/boxel-ui/components';
```
